resources.string: Kestrel reads the screen and acts on it when you ask, so that you can use the phone by voice. What it reads stays on the phone, except what you choose to send to your own AI provider.

While test mode is on, Kestrel sends and shares only to Telegram\'s Saved Messages, WhatsApp\'s Message yourself, Viber\'s My Notes and your own email address, and it makes no calls. Keep it on while you test Kestrel.
The safety mode, agent-free apps and screenshot approvals come with Kestrel\'s agent.
Delete the activity log and the network log? This cannot be undone.
No entries in the last 7 days.
Kestrel could not write the file.
Kestrel is installed. scripts\\install.ps1 installs it with adb. On a Samsung phone, Auto Blocker must be off while USB debugging is on.
scripts\\push-models.ps1 will copy the models from your computer. This step comes with Kestrel\'s voice features.
Kestrel reads the screen and acts on it through this service.
Kestrel listens for your voice and shows what it is doing in a notification.
So that Android does not stop Kestrel. On a Samsung phone, also add Kestrel to \"Never sleeping apps\" in the battery settings.
Make Kestrel the default digital assistant
Optional: for the side key and earbuds. This step comes with Kestrel\'s voice features.
Sign in to an AI provider and choose the models
This step comes with Kestrel\'s provider settings.
Optional: so that Voice Access and Kestrel do not react to the same words.
Voice Access and Kestrel are both on, so they may react to the same words.
